text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Duramente
meticulously warming up
on the academy track.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ........Does it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Today, I promised to run alongside my senior.
Nothing less than my absolute best run will do.

Among all the senior Umamusume,
Duramente holds Air Groove in especially high regard and admiration.
Judging by how much effort she's putting into this...
choice_data_list: Could your training partner be Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ........That is true, but.
Duramente's expression suddenly turned stern!
choice_data_list: Could it be that your legs are……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I've felt a slight stiffness since this morning.
It's not an injury, however.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A respected senior is giving me her precious time.
All I can do is get myself in the best condition possible.

Driven by a sense of responsibility,
Duramente seems resolved to run alongside her no matter what.
choice_data_list: ...I can't help but worry about your health.
Hopefully a good run will get you back in top form.

Duramente seems resolved to run alongside her no matter what.
choice_data_list: ...I can't help but worry about your health.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: To think that someone challenging the world stage would falter at this level...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I heard, Dura.
Did you think a change in plans would sour my mood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Groove-nee.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You know your own body best.
Adjust things today until you are satisfied.
—Tomorrow, same place, same time. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Rather than blaming me, she cheered me on.
—She is truly the one whose back I must strive to follow.

After that, Duramente silently
continued her running drills.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'll bring it back. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It's time for our tandem run.
Are you ready, Dura?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Of course. I shall take it under advisement.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I, too, was looking forward to slicing through the wind together.
However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—If the pain in your leg worsens even slightly,
don't hide it—tell me right away.
I respect your passion, but pulling a muscle will only drag things out.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sister Groove...
...Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, get on the track.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah...!

Showing no signs of fatigue, Duramente ran alongside
Air Groove, sending thrilling excitement
throughout the track.
